create.name: Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Nantes
create.bio:
Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Nantes is a centre certified by the French Iyengar association, in the Procé quarter of Nantes in western France. It is the school of Hubert Corbrejaud, who has taught yoga since 1979 and brought the Iyengar method to the Loire-Atlantique in 1991. He made ten study trips to Pune to learn from B.K.S. Iyengar, Geeta and Prashant, organised the national Iyengar convention held in Nantes in 1999, served as vice-president and then president of the Association Française de Yoga Iyengar, and still follows the weekly classes given at the Pune institute.

The light, garden-facing practice room is stocked with the wall ladder, ropes, benches and wooden props the method relies on. Weekly classes run through the school year from September to June, either in the room or live on Zoom, with a trial class for beginners and private lessons available. Sunday morning workshops through the year are pitched at intermediate, advanced or mixed levels, and longer series of half-day sessions are held in Nantes in April and in July for students who want a more sustained period of study.

courses.title: Tarifs cours 2026/2027 (weekly classes, in person or on Zoom)
courses.description: Weekly Iyengar classes taken by the week, month, term or full school year, in the room or by Zoom, with a 12-class card and private lessons. Couples and under-26s receive a reduction.

courses.title: Stage de Yoga Niveau Intermédiaire-Avancé – 15 novembre 2026
courses.description: A three-hour Sunday morning workshop with Hubert Corbrejaud for intermediate and advanced students, at the centre or online.

courses.title: Les stages de yoga 2026/2027 (workshop programme)
courses.description: The year's Sunday morning workshops, each for a stated level, plus a week of half-day sessions in April 2027 and a summer week in July 2027, all in Nantes and also available online.
courses.price: Demi-journée / matinée: 44 €; Demi-journées à Nantes en avril 2027: 160 €; Semaine à Nantes en juillet 2027: 361 € (sans repas et sans hébergement)
